text:
maria: Quick sync — I'm trying to nail the UX for SLA-driven automatic fallback. We need a clear ledger of signals that can trigger a degrade (latency p50/p95/p99, error-rate, token-drop, model-crash, region-availability). Want opinions on minimal required fields for the audit log and console surface.

simon: +1. For audit we should capture: signal_type, threshold, sample_window, raw_metric_value, decision (allow/fallback), downstream_model, operator_override, incident_id (if any).

lee: and also include the evaluated expression + version of policy that made the decision. Otherwise replaying is hard.

jules: agree. UX question: do we show raw values in the runbook or only aggregated snapshots? hiding raw can make incident triage slower.

maria: prefer both — snapshot for quick glance, expandable raw stream for deep dive. Console mock: "SLA Signal Ledger" with columns: time, signal, value, decision, policy-id, runbook-link, operator.

ops-bot: policy-service:autofallback v2.4 deployed to canary cluster (region-us-west).

simon: for the ledger row format proposal:
```
{
  "ts": 1679999999,
  "policy_id": "autofallback-v2.4",
  "signal": "p95_latency",
  "window": "60s",
  "value": "1800ms",
  "threshold": "1500ms",
  "decision": "fallback",
  "target": "gptq-8k-quant",
  "operator_override": null
}
```

lee: we should also log the routing context: route_id, customer_tier, pinned_model (if any) — so we can see why a fallback chose a particular model.

jules: edge case: transient spikes vs sustained. UX should show why decision fired: e.g., "spike (1 sample)" vs "sustained (3/5 windows)". Otherwise operators will just flip overrides constantly.

maria: good call. Add a field `firing_pattern` with enum {spike, sustained, hysteresis}.

jules: retention question: how long do we keep raw entries? 90d seems expensive at token-level telemetry. Maybe ledger rows are small and keep 180d, raw traces 30d. Thoughts?

simon: 180d for ledger (small rows) + 30d for raw detail is reasonable. We need to expose a retention label in the UI and an API to export slices for audits.

lee: UI affordance: allow filtering by policy-id, signal, route, customer, and operator. Also pin breadcrumbs to the timeline so you can correlate with deploys/scale events.

maria: front-end: add a "why-this-decision" flyout that shows the evaluated expression, metric series sparkline, and last 5 related ledger rows. That should be compact but informative.

ops-bot: alert: cluster-us-west p95 latency > threshold at 4876543222 (auto-fallback triggered).

jules: one more: for operator overrides we need immutability + reason field. If someone flips a fallback off, store the reason and the optional TTL. That needs to surface in audit exports.

simon: and a safety: operator override should not be allowed to persist longer than 24h without an SLA-approved justification. We can add a lint in the console before saving.

maria: action items: 1) simon: draft ledger row schema (include firing_pattern, routing_context). 2) lee: mockup flyout + filters. 3) jules: propose retention defaults + export API surface. 4) infra: confirm storage cost estimate for 180d ledger + 30d raw.

jules: I'll take retention + export API. posting a quick sketch in figma later.

simon: I'll open a PR with the ledger schema and sample queries for telemetry team.

lee: will drop a prototype mock next hour.

maria: thanks — sync-up tmrw 10am. If anyone wants to add corner cases: please drop here.

ops-bot: note: thread pinned to eng-platform channel by ops-bot.
